resources.string: Inspect imported files in the local library on this device. No account or A2D server is required.

Rust import APIs must own archive traversal, resource limits, conflict detection, durable staging, audit events, and merge decisions. This screen does not fabricate imported rows or silently merge data in Kotlin.
Import rows are supplied by injected presentation state; retry, review, and merge actions remain callback-only until Rust import APIs are connected.
Imports must never overwrite an existing page, scan, Notebook, Page Set, collection, or asset without an explicit reviewed merge decision.
Imported PDFs, images, Markdown, text, JSON, and future backup inspections will appear here after Rust supplies durable import records.
